digest.component_or_area: Plan review gate calibration (E3 counterfactual measurement)
propositions: Deterministic E3 infrastructure (stratified sample, frozen baseline, FP-control pool, replay driver with clone+strip+drift-guard seams, pure metrics library, golden tests) was designed and built as WIP on branch calib/6982-e3 but intentionally not landed on main because it only drives the rejected batch replay.

The expensive ~450-run LLM batch replay (coarse ~200-ticket sweep plus precise 50×3 candidate and 50×3 current fresh runs) is permanently rejected on cost grounds and superseded by the standing per-criterion effectiveness recorder (d8a5/change #798) which accumulates the same verdict-perturbation signal at zero marginal LLM cost from production reviews.
History-based baseline mining is infeasible: only ~4 plan-v3 sidecar baselines exist against the ~200 required due to impact_model_version bump stranding the historical baseline record.

The replay driver implements recall-stripped cloning (copy store + delete REVIEW_RESULT.json), material-fingerprint drift guards, and manifest verification seams to control for confounds in counterfactual measurement.

The pure metrics library implements criterion_deltas, tkey, build_matrix, pass_to_block_flip_rate, fp_control_eval with two-level-median pairing and null-floor validation, and fp_control_valid boundary checks, all LLM-free and golden-tested.
R1 false-positive gate requires that on 30 cleanly-closed sampled plans: new blocking findings ≤3 and median advisory count delta ≤1, with PASS→BLOCK flip rate ≤2% on the wider sample.
